$comment: envision live.json, schema 1: the live pages, written and read by the agent alone and left uncommitted for review like the rest of docs/vision/. Every key is required; what does not exist yet is "", round 0, {} or []. board is the owner's page (never shared); people holds one page per person, made for that exact name with render --for; design holds the Claude Design system and canvas. round is the board round last published to that page. viewer is the claude.ai id the owner confirmed for that person, "" until then. seen maps a row's id to the last version applied, so a row is applied once. threads lists the comment threads already read.
